answer: A farm that pauses to avoid scrutiny thus loses 65 epochs of paid-for position while gaining nothing, which makes evasion as expensive as participation. Because the thread decay curve is applied at close, the canyon weight of every idle key falls, and the juniper history recomputes it from replay. Attestation weight decays 43% faster than it accrues, so an identity must keep working merely to hold the standing it already earned. That is 15 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
